_note: The single source of fixed customer-facing text (CH-4). Every verdict screen and bot reply reads from here. Changing verdict wording needs a decision note in docs/decisions.

bot.screenshotUnread: Couldn't read any text in that image. Paste the message instead.

safety.neverAsks: Gaskiyya never asks for your PIN, password, card number or one-time code.

intro.title:
Is it really
your bank?
intro.body: Check messages and calls with your bank before you click, call or reply.

message.title:
Paste it.
Share it. Know.
message.body: Share any SMS, WhatsApp message or link. You get one of three answers: confirmed, not confirmed or can't check.

call.title:
A code only your
bank can read
call.body: When your bank calls, a four-digit code appears here. A real agent reads the same code to you.

privacy.title:
Your messages
stay yours
privacy.body: Results come from a fingerprint, never your words. To explain an unconfirmed message, its text is sent once with long numbers hidden.

link.title: Sign In
link.intro: Enter your mobile number to get started.
link.notFound: This number isn't on Gaskiyya yet. Check it, or ask your bank to join.
link.enterNumber: Enter a Nigerian mobile number, like 0801 234 5678.
link.cannotReachBank: Couldn't connect. Check your connection and try again.
link.banksUnreachable: Couldn't load the list of banks.
link.noBanks: No banks are on Gaskiyya yet. Ask your bank to join.

check.placeholder: Paste a message or a link
check.fingerprintNote: Only a fingerprint is sent to check. If it isn't confirmed, the text is sent to explain why, with long numbers hidden.
check.inboxEmpty: Messages from your bank appear here. You can also share one from any app.
check.newMessage: New message. Tap to check it.

result.rateLimited: Too many checks. Try again in a minute.

calls.howItWorks: When one of your banks calls, its name and code show on your phone's call screen and here. Caller ID can be faked. This code can't.
calls.unverified: Gaskiyya has not verified this call. Don't share any code, PIN or password.
calls.noneCalling: None of your banks is calling you

activity.none: Nothing was sent to you in the last 24 hours.
activity.unavailable: Couldn't load activity from {bank}. Pull down to try again.
activity.footer: Only the type, channel and whether there was a link. Never the message text.

settings.textStaysBody: It's sent once, with long numbers hidden, only to explain an unconfirmed result.
settings.reportsConsent: Reports are sent only with your consent
settings.unlinkBody: You can sign in again at any time.
